question: Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is the option no 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the context of the sentence and the use of articles given in the options.
 
 
• The line " At last we came to a peaceful island.
 
• In this line, the word **"Peaceful" is working as an adjective**(Adj)who is modifying the noun (island) 
 
• **Peaceful means** free from disturbance; tranquil
 
• **the island means** a piece of land surrounded by water.
 
• Article **A (before a singular noun beginning with a consonant sound)**
 
• **An (before a singular noun beginning with a vowel sound)**
 
 
 
• So, the correct answer is **an i .e option no 1****​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** **In English, there are three articles: a, an, and the.

 
 
• Articles are used before nouns or noun equivalents and are a type of adjective.
 
• The definite article (the) is used before a noun to indicate that the identity of the noun is known to the reader.
 
• The indefinite article (a, an) is used before a noun that is general or when its identity is not known.
 
• **The** (before a singular or plural noun)
 
• **A** (before a singular noun beginning with a consonant sound)
 
• **An **(before a singular noun beginning with a vowel sound)
